Coupang正在重新定義購物體驗，目標是從顧客開啟 Coupang App 的那一刻起，到商品送達門口為止，持續創造超越期待的服務。Coupang 在台灣提供「火箭速配」，以實惠價格為廣泛商品提供隔日到貨服務，以及「火箭跨境」，為來自韓國、美國及其他地區的數百萬件熱銷商品提供免費國際配送。我們正在尋找能共同引領 Coupang 台灣業務擴展的人才。這是一個參與 Coupang 台灣成長的重要機會，並共同打造一個讓顧客感嘆「沒有 Coupang 的日子，我以前是怎麼過的？」的世界。
職位名稱: Senior Customer Service Quality Assurance Specialist
What will you do?
負責台灣客服品質改善策略，透過品質稽核、學習發展及知識管理機制，持續提升客服體驗與營運表現。
運用客服工單、品質評分及營運數據辨識趨勢與根因，將分析結果轉化為可執行的改善方案。
建立並追蹤品質與學習成效 KPI，確保改善措施能有效支持快速成長的電商與配送服務。
與客服營運、培訓、知識管理、產品、物流及外部服務供應商合作，推動跨部門品質改善計畫。
在快速變動的營運環境中主動處理優先事項，協助 Coupang 持續為台灣顧客創造 WOW 體驗。
Key Responsibilities:
規劃並執行台灣客服品質保證與持續改善策略，涵蓋品質監控、校準、回饋、培訓及知識管理流程。
分析客服工單、顧客回饋、品質稽核及營運數據，辨識影響顧客體驗與服務效率的趨勢、風險及根本原因。
使用 Excel 獨立且快速建立儀表板、分析模型及臨時報表，支援緊急業務需求與管理決策。
建立並追蹤關鍵品質指標，例如品質評分、問題重複發生率、改善措施完成率、培訓後成效及顧客體驗相關指標。
將數據洞察轉化為具體改善行動，明確定義負責人、時程、成功指標及後續追蹤機制。
領導跨部門品質改善專案，與客服營運、學習發展、知識管理、產品、技術、物流、配送及其他內外部合作夥伴協作。
針對 Rocket Delivery、Rocket Overseas 及其他 app-first 電商服務的顧客接觸流程，提出可擴展且符合台灣市場需求的品質改善方案。
與內部團隊及 BPO 服務供應商進行品質校準，提升評分一致性、政策理解與顧客服務標準。
管理多項並行專案，主動辨識執行風險、排定優先順序，並定期向利害關係人彙報進度、成果及待決事項。
推動以顧客為中心、數據驅動及持續學習的品質文化，確保改善成果能落實至第一線客服流程並創造顧客 WOW。
Essential Qualifications:
具 5 年以上學習與發展、品質保證或知識管理相關經驗，其中至少 2 年具策略規劃、專案領導或團隊管理經驗。
具電子商務或 BPO 客服營運環境的實務經驗，了解高交易量及快速變動服務情境下的品質管理需求。
熟悉客服工單系統及相關工作流程，例如 Zendesk，並能運用工單資料進行問題分析與改善追蹤。
熟練使用 Excel，能獨立建立儀表板、樞紐分析、趨勢報告及其他分析工具，將資料洞察轉化為具體行動。
具良好的分析、問題解決及專案管理能力，能定義 KPI、衡量學習或品質改善成效，並同時管理多項專案。
具出色的溝通、影響及跨部門協作能力，能與不同層級的內部利害關係人及外部服務供應商合作。
具商業、教育、傳播、語言或其他相關領域學士學位。
具高度主人翁意識、行動導向及數據驅動思維，能在資訊不完整及步調快速的環境中獨立判斷並推進工作。
Preferred Qualifications:
具 Power BI、Tableau 或其他資料視覺化工具的實務經驗，能建立易於理解且可供決策使用的管理儀表板。
具客服品質框架、品質校準、根因分析、改善行動管理或培訓成效評估的設計與導入經驗。
曾領導跨客服營運、產品、技術、物流或配送團隊的端到端改善專案。
具管理 BPO 品質表現、供應商治理或外包客服合作關係的經驗。
熟悉電商、即時零售、最後一哩配送或跨境電商服務與相關顧客旅程。
具流程改善、品質管理或專案管理相關認證或方法論經驗，例如 Lean、Six Sigma 或 PMP。
具良好的中文及英文溝通能力，能在跨國或跨文化團隊中進行書面溝通、資料彙報及專案協作。
能配合輪班制度，標準工作時間為上午 9:00 至下午 6:00，並依排班於週末及國定假日出勤；實際安排可能依營運流程調整。

○ 面試安排及結果將透過候選人於申請階段所提供的電子郵件地址通知。

○ 若候選人在申請流程中提交不實資訊，Coupang 有權撤回聘僱邀請。

And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Experience As the Senior Director within the Salesforce Controllership group, you will be the strategic owner of our Finance system architecture, data flow, and enhancement roadmap. It is a critical leadership position requiring you to bridge the gap between complex accounting requirements and technical execution. You will oversee initiatives, drive the evolution of our Workday Cloud ERP ecosystem, and ensure AI is at the forefront of our financial automation strategy. AI & Automation Roadmap: Champion and lead initiatives to continuously automate and enhance the ERP system, actively identifying and integrating AI-driven solutions to modernize accounting workflows. Technology & Business Liaison: Serve as a key bridge between the Accounting function and the Digital Enterprise Transformation (DET) team. You will help articulate clear business facts, define requirements, and support critical design decisions to ensure our systems support our accounting needs. Executive Communication & Storytelling: Transform complex project updates and accounting data into clear, compelling narratives. Job Description: This position is responsible for producing advanced learning content to support the learning and performance needs defined by Broadcom Education for a variety of audiences and behaviors to achieve strategic business goals . Work with senior management to conduct job, task, and needs analysis to identify strategically aligned learning and performance initiatives and design and develop blended learning and performance support solutions in a variety of delivery modes and mix of technologies (e.g., instructor-led training, self-paced training, collaboration tools, other online learning support, etc.). It may also procure and manage external vendors and measure the business impact and effectiveness of deployed learning and performance solutions. May assist the department manager in mentoring and coaching other instructional designers and relevant staff. Key Responsibilities Conduct job, task, knowledge, and skills analysis to determine learning and performance needs, and work with senior management and employees to identify these needs per business priorities. Lead the design and implementation of curriculum and develop appropriate plans to assist in achieving organizational goals, including working with external vendors to ensure learning content is tailored to Broadcom culture and practices. Ensure that learning content is consistently integrated across curriculum and roles and is tailored to audience-specific needs and learning requirements. Lead the creation and updating of current instructional and performance strategies and processes. Work with subject matter experts to gather, analyze, and organize content that will be designed and developed into learning content. Work with other Broadcom groups such as Development, Support, Services, and Marketing to plan and execute objectives. When necessary, meet with different levels of employees/customers/partners to plan work and solicit feedback and requirements. Work with other Curriculum Development Team members to ensure consistent presentation and delivery mechanisms for learning content. Validate the effectiveness of learning content using appropriate methods. Work with the Learning Systems and Infrastructure Team to coordinate development efforts with plans to implement new learning delivery systems internally to employees and/or externally to partners. Additional responsibilities for Technical Trainer working as SMEs to develop technical learning content and performance support for different audiences : Serve as the technical expert on content development projects and ensure the instructional and learning integrity of curriculum under development utilizing Broadcom’s Services Best Practices. Demonstrate expertise with all the major products within designated solutions, plus one to two additional complementary products and/or best practices. Familiar with cross-brand solutions and integration. As an advisor and expert, the Instructional Designer will attend and participate in curriculum analysis and design workshops, technical walk-throughs, pilot classes, and other assigned development activities. For assigned projects, ensure technical accuracy and completeness of content concerning the curriculum and design in conjunction with Broadcom’s Services Best Practices. Collaborate with team members for curriculum development to maintain learning paths and curriculum roadmaps. Articulate at a granular level a Solution's vision, capabilities, business value, and offerings to internal and external customers and prospects. Support Sales and Technical Sales with Education solution development by providing information on products and offerings and assisting with specific sales opportunities. Develop software images and environments and other technology support, as appropriate, to support the application of products as part of learning content and performance support solutions. Complete understanding and wide application of the field's principles, theories, and concepts. General knowledge of other related disciplines. Strong competence with the various tools, procedures, and programming languages used to accomplish the job. Usually works with minimal supervision, conferring with a supervisor on unusual matters. Less senior level employees may be assisted by (and sometimes direct). Requires daily decision-making capabilities and actions that may not be reviewed by superiors. Assignments are broad in nature and need ingenuity and originality to solve. Contributes to moderately complex aspects of a project. May assist more junior staff members with aspects of their job. Works on problems of diverse scope where data analysis requires evaluation of identifiable factors. May play a role in high-level projects that impact the company’s future direction. Job-Specific Authority and Scope Generally, work without consulting their manager. Independent decisions are made daily. Examples of typical decisions without manager consultation: Make strategic and tactical decisions that directly affect the curriculum development function. Apply knowledge, skills, and experience to create new curriculum development approaches, processes, and systems. Resolve conflicts and escalate any irresolvable conflicts or deviations from corporate policy. Typically, has no direct reports. Typically, has no total staff. Typically, has a global geographic focus. Typically, does not manage a budget. Exceptional skills in leadership, time management, facilitation, and organization. Experience in managing stakeholders. Outstanding knowledge of change management principles and performance evaluation processes Ability to work in a physical office environment at one of our listed locations Preferred Skills and Qualifications Strong working knowledge of software education Strong working knowledge of mainframe software Strong working knowledge of the mainframe app dev environment and developer’s experience in modern mainframe environments Experience with data analytics Compensation and Benefits The annual base salary range for this position is USD 90,000.00 To USD 144,000.00 As a valued member of our team, you'll be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus and the opportunity to receive not only a competitive new hire equity grant, but also annual equity awards, connecting your success directly to the company's growth. jobs.description: Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity. The ideal candidate is a technologist and storyteller in equal measure — someone who can go deep on frequency propagation, network architecture, or enterprise connectivity infrastructure, and then translate that depth into crisp, differentiated messaging that moves technical decision-makers to act. You will drive the technical content strategy end-to-end: from positioning and messaging frameworks to solution briefs, reference architectures, technical whitepapers, thought leadership articles, and competitive intelligence. Create high-impact technical content including solution briefs, technical whitepapers, reference architectures, deployment guides, thought leadership articles, demo scripts, RFP response templates, and executive presentations. Synthesize customer feedback, analyst input, and market data to identify positioning gaps and content opportunities, and feed insights back into product strategy. Develop and deliver technical presentations and demonstrations for both technical and executive audiences, and support field teams with technical training, content, and tools that accelerate the sales cycle. jobs.description: Job Description Summary Seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Production Test Operator to join our manufacturing team. The successful candidate will be responsible for performing routine testing of current transformers (CT) as well as tightness testing (gas leak chambers) of circuit breakers, and Dielectric testing in the High Voltage lab to ensure compliance with customer specifications, internal quality standards, and testing requirements. This role requires attention to detail, and a commitment to maintaining a safe and efficient testing environment. Job Description Essential Duties and Responsibilities Current Transformer (CT) Testing · Perform current transformer tests measuring Hi-pot, ratios, and additional testing as needed following the requirements of the approved Inspection and Test Plans (PIT) using appropriate equipment and apparatus, Manuals and Standards Troubleshooting and communication of failures including Quality Concern Reports (QCRs) Gas Tightness Testing · Perform gas tightness testing on circuit breakers following the requirements of the approved Inspection and Test Plans (PIT) using appropriate equipment and apparatus, Manuals and Standards Troubleshooting and locate any leaks and then communication of failures including Quality Concern Reports (QCRs) High Voltage Dielectric Testing · Perform high voltage dielectric testing on circuit breakers following the requirements of the approved Inspection and Test Plans (PIT) using appropriate equipment and apparatus, Manuals and Standards Troubleshooting and locate any leaks and then communication of failures including Quality Concern Reports (QCRs) Other Duties Responsibilities include moving breakers into, out of, and around the lab using the appropriate equipment and following the safety rules. Accurately document test data, prepare test reports, and ensure full traceability of test records. Compare results against specifications, record test data, and print test results. Document all work performed by completing the appropriate forms. Support continuous improvement initiatives to enhance test procedures, reduce downtime, and improve product quality. Maintain a clean, safe, and organized work area in compliance with company and OSHA standards. Work comfortably in a high-voltage testing environment with appropriate PPE. Lift and maneuver test equipment and components weighing up to 35 lbs. as part of daily responsibilities. Exposure to loud noise, high voltage, and moving equipment; strict adherence to safety protocols is required. Confer with engineers, technicians, production personnel, and customers regarding testing procedures, results, and problem resolution. Required Qualifications Education High school diploma or equivalent required. Associate's degree or technical diploma in Electrical Engineering Technology preferred. Experience Minimum of two years of related experience in test, quality control, or manufacturing environment. Desired Characteristics & Technical Skills Ability to read and interpret documents such as schematics, test standards, inspection and test procedures, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals. Ability to read and interpret documents such as IEEE and IEC circuit breaker and test standards, inspection and test procedures, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions and procedure manuals. Ability to speak effectively, write routine reports and correspondence. Must be articulate and professional, with good interpersonal skills because of frequent customer witness tests in the test lab.

POSITION SUMMARY
Manager role within SPV Controllership responsible for supporting end-to-end financial oversight of APAC deal stacks, including APAC-based SPVs and aggregator entities. The role is heavily focused on oversight of third-party administrators and works in partnership with the global SPV Controllership team to support monthly financial closes, review administrator-prepared trial balances under multiple GAAPs including IFRS, and assist with distribution oversight. The individual must be well-versed in accounting standards with strong experience reviewing and challenging management accounts. ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES
Administrator Oversight & Monthly Close
• Act as a primary point of oversight for third-party administrators across APAC-based SPVs and aggregator entities.

Financial Control, Budgets & Cash
• Review and approve budgets at deal close to ensure SPVs are adequately funded for post-close and ongoing operating expenses

• Coordinate periodic cleardown of intercompany payables and receivables between SPVs and other KKR group entities, where applicable
• Computation of management fees for SPV entities
Aggregators, Distributions & Holding Stack Oversight

• Review and challenge distribution calculations and distribution lead sheets, ensuring consistency across the structure and alignment between Finance, Tax, and Accounting
• Liaise with KKR Deal Teams/Operation Teams as required to support financial control matters relating to deal SPVs and aggregator entities
Governance, Audit & Compliance

• Ensure audit and administrator billings are in line with agreed Engagement Letters and contractual arrangements

• Partner with Tax, Legal, and Treasury teams to support SPV-related processes, including distributions, audits, compliance requirements, and cash movements

• Assist with projects and ad hoc requests as needed, such as but not limited to:
o Assist in driving business process simplifications and efficiency initiatives
o Build out the policy and procedure documentation surrounding fund admins
• Assist with various ad hoc projects and workstreams as required associated with financial control activity with respect to SPV Controllership
• Collaborate with members of the SPV Controllership team to gather and review relevant data for reporting purposes.
QUALIFICATIONS

• ACA/ACCA/CIMA/CA qualification required
• Prior Private Equity Fund Administration or Audit experience is required
• Experience working within a financial services environment or comparable corporate environment
• Ability to establish priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced, high growth environment

• Detailed oriented with a proven track record for accuracy

jobs.description: ABOUT SUNO We're building the world's first creative entertainment platform, where the entire world can feel the joy and fulfillment of making music. In 2026, we raised a $400 million Series D at a $5.4 billion valuation to continue building innovative products that amplify creativity and imagination. ABOUT THE ROLE For most people, making music has always felt out of reach. Suno is changing that, and mobile is where that change will happen for the majority of people. We are looking for a Senior Qualitative UX Researcher to own the deepest questions about the people we haven't reached yet. Not the users who already know what a stem is, but the ones who open the app with no idea what's possible and no vocabulary for what they want. Understanding how creative confidence gets built, across a very wide range of ages and levels of experience, is one of the highest-leverage research problems at the company right now. You'll be the research partner to the PM and designer leading mobile create and working alongside them to address shared product questions. You’ll also collaborate with the researcher focused on rapid mobile evaluation, ensuring that usability insights and foundational research inform one another. This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership. You’ll develop and advocate for the research roadmap, adapt it as priorities evolve, and confidently revise your perspective when new evidence emerges. Listen to the song we made about this role! https://suno.com/s/Asd2doVRgxJzjenY WHAT YOU'LL DO Own the foundational research agenda for mobile create - Define and run the generative studies that shape where the product goes: ethnography, diary and longitudinal studies, in-context observation, concept work. Decide what's worth studying, and say no to what won't change a decision. Go where the creating happens - Lead in-person and in-field research, including in-home sessions and sessions with more than one participant at once, such as household and group settings. Some of the most important behavior here will never show up in a remote unmoderated test. Be a true partner, not a service desk - Sit with the mobile create PM, designer, and engineers as decisions are being made. Bring user signal early enough to change the shape of the work, not late enough to only validate it. Turn findings into things the org keeps using - Segmentations, journey and jobs-to-be-done frameworks, opportunity maps, design principles that outlive any single launch and get cited in rooms you're not in. Connect qual to the numbers - Pair depth with survey and behavioral data. Work with data science as a peer to size what you find, and with growth partners to translate insight into acquisition, onboarding, and retention bets. Raise the craft bar - Mentor, review study designs, and unblock other researchers. This is an IC role with real influence, not a management track. WHO YOU ARE - 5+ years of industry UX research experience, with deep specialization in qualitative methods and consumer mobile products - A track record of research that shifted strategy, not just UI. You can name the roadmap decisions, product bets, or reversals your work drove - Experience running in-person research with groups, including in-home and in-context sessions, sessions with more than one participant at a time, and the consent and assent workflows that come with them - Rigorous methodological judgment and the range to match method to question rather than reaching for the same study every time - Sound instincts about ethics and participant comfort with people who are not professional research subjects - Fluency with quantitative data. You can read an experiment readout, design a survey that holds up, and hold your own with a data scientist - Genuinely self-directed. You find the important question before anyone assigns it, and you have a high tolerance for ambiguity, shifting priorities, and moving faster than feels comfortable - The ability to influence senior stakeholders without authority, and to hold a position when the room disagrees - Excited by consumer products, creativity, music, and AI, and by the idea that the interaction patterns for this category don't exist yet WHAT YOU'LL NEED - Startup experience, especially as the first or only researcher, or as a founder (even with a research team around you, this role runs on ownership rather than process) - Experience in sensitive product areas such as safety, trust, or wellbeing - Background in consumer mobile in audio, music, or social - Experience researching AI and generative products, where user mental models are still forming NICE TO HAVES - PhD in HCI, Human-Centered Computing, Psychology, Learning Sciences, or a related field, combined with real industry experience. - You know of a good UX research lab or in-person session space in LA that we could use, and bonus points if you've worked out of it - Bonus points if you've used Suno to make music Additional Notes - You must be authorized to work in the United States - You must be willing to work 5 days per week at our Venice Beach office - Some travel for team meetings and field research Perks & Benefits for Full-Time Employees - Company Equity Package - 401(k) with 3% Employer Match & Roth 401(k) - Medical, Dental, & Vision Insurance (PPO w/ HSA & FSA options) - 11 Paid Holidays + Unlimited PTO & Sick Time - 16 Weeks of Paid Parental Leave - Creative Education Stipend - Generous Commuter Allowance - In-Office Lunch (5 days per week) Compensation The annual salary range for this role is: $176K-$220K (before equity) Suno is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.
